# PRicapa.com

> Pricilla Ricapa is an economist, MBA, and technology strategist based in Boston who translates AI infrastructure, quantum computing, and capital-markets shifts into strategic clarity for business leaders and investors. She is not a physicist or computer scientist — her value is bridging technical researchers and decision-makers.

## Background
- Peruvian-born economist and MBA (Simon Business School), fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
- Career: investor relations at JRC and Repsol Peru, consumer goods at Belcorp, digital transformation at Volvo Group (built "Dr. Volvo," an AI diagnostic app), Product & AI Strategy at Lumentum Holdings (contributed to enterprise RAG systems).
- Co-founder of Prifit, an early-stage fitness & apparel startup.
- Active participant in the global AI/quantum conversation: WEF Davos, MIT, Harvard, TEDxMIT, TEDxBoston, IEEE, Dassault Systèmes.

## Topics she covers
1. AI infrastructure and the dual-architecture (AI + quantum) compute era
2. Economics of the AI transition — the agentic economy and SaaS business-model disruption
3. Quantum computing strategy for non-technical business leaders
4. Societal and philosophical implications of the AGI transition
5. Capital allocation patterns in AI and quantum investment
6. Leadership, identity, and career navigation in the intelligence era

Weekly written and video analysis on these topics is published on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pricilla-ricapa/

## Services
- Speaking & panels on AI infrastructure economics, quantum strategy, and the intelligence era for business audiences.
- 1:1 or team strategic advisory on quantum timelines, AI infrastructure positioning, and capital allocation strategy — for investors and C-suite.
- Content and education: written analysis, video explainers, and workshops.

## Credentials
Anthropic-issued: Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol, Building with the Claude API, AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations, Claude 101. Also: Top 100 Voices (Massachusetts AI Coalition) and Claude Community Ambassador (Claude Community, Boston).
